responsibility: This file contains C-family frontend support specific to the VMS target. It registers and implements VMS pragmas that affect parsing and declaration semantics, including member alignment, extern model, extern prefix, message handling, and pointer-size control; it also augments include-path handling by discovering VMS header modules with custom filename construction, initializes default pointer mode from target options, and provides the default __CRTL_VER and __VMS_VER builtin macro values consumed by vms.h.
